description: Authentication information is displayed in clear text during entry rather than being obscured. This signal indicates that passwords or other credentials may be visible to shoulder surfing or screen capture.
applicability: Applicable to all authentication interfaces. Includes password entry fields, PIN entry, command-line authentication, and any credential input mechanism.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through authentication interface review, input field configuration testing, and credential display assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Identification and Authentication
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
